implementation.discovery: Exact disjunctive guest states; up to 64 complete states per (mode, PC), 100000 globally, and 64 abstract memory words per state. Adjacent immediate CMP/conditional-branch refinement supports ARM and Thumb. Branch successor masks are finalized after convergence.
implementation.rom_ldmia: Thumb LDMIA uses an ordered AOT table for 2..=16 proven ROM bases; runtime table miss returns EXIT_FAULT with fault code 7. No ROM image pointer or interpreter/JIT fallback is emitted.

parallelism_benchmark.scope: Eight independent ADD/SUB fixture modes, each compiled and executed at O0/O2 with manifest checks; full gate was not executed per benchmark sample.
parallelism_benchmark.comparison: 7 workers x 1 LLD thread versus 1 worker x 10 LLD threads; three samples per configuration in interleaved pairs.
parallelism_benchmark.fixture_checks: All eight modes passed O0/O2 runtime state and strict-AOT manifest checks.
parallelism_benchmark.harness_method: A temporary harness extracted verify_thumb_addsub() and its eight calls from scripts/verify-gba020.sh before thumb_addsub_bx_rom. A Python subprocess wrapper ran /usr/bin/time -lp for each trial.
limitations: The temporary harness and complete wrapper were not preserved, and the exact order of the six samples was not recorded.
The compiler binary hash at the time of each sample was not saved; the current binary hash above is not asserted to identify those historical samples.
No hard scheduler CPU cap, continuous CPU sampling, or aggregate worker RSS measurement was collected; time -lp RSS is per command and does not sum workers.
The result measures synthetic fixture throughput, not a single commercial ROM compilation.
